transcript.answer: No, not anymore. Nightly runs were added on 2026-10-02 in PR #2463: a `.github/workflows/context-evals.yml` workflow that ran every night at 03:17 UTC and could also be started by hand. PR #2823, merged 2026-10-19, removed that workflow. The evals now run only from a developer machine with `node scripts/context-evals/run.mjs` against the deployed lore-api, and nothing runs them on a schedule. The PR gives two reasons: the evals are experiments a person runs and writes up, and the unattended run had gone red three nights in a row (10-17 to 10-19) on a single `demo-factory-todo` document.

judgements.reason: The answer says no, and that nightly runs began on 2026-10-02 via #2463 and have since stopped, which matches the gold answer (truncated after 'until'); the extra removal details do not contradict it.
